description:
Offline falling blocks: 600 certified floors, daily challenge, Marathon and Zen

Block Night is a falling-blocks game set in a city at night. Climb twelve districts of fifty floors each: every floor has its own goal, from clearing lines to lighting windows or digging through garbage, and a budget of pieces to do it.

Every floor can be cleared. Each of the 1,800 variants ships with a solution certificate, found by an offline solver and replayed with the same engine that runs the game. A floor always deals the same pieces, so losing never changes your luck.

Features

  • 600 floors, each tuned separately for Easy, Medium and Hard
  • Seven kinds of goals: lines, score, Quads, T-Spins, combos, lit windows and garbage
  • Concrete, rising garbage and floors without Hold
  • Daily challenge: one floor per day and difficulty
  • Free play: Marathon, Sprint 40, Ultra 2:00 and Zen
  • SRS rotation, 7-bag, Hold, ghost piece, T-Spins, back-to-back, combos and perfect clears
  • Gestures over the whole play area or an on-screen pad with adjustable DAS and ARR, both with a left-handed layout
  • Stars, statistics, records and achievements
  • Progress export and import through the system file picker
  • English and Portuguese

Privacy

No internet permission, no ads, no tracking and no accounts. Your progress stays on your device.
